Glutamine
Possibly effective for use in burn 
patients, bone marrow trans-
plants, burns, critical illness 
(trauma), AIDS wasting, oral 
mucositis and improve nitrogen 
balance in surgery. Conflicting 
evidence for use in diarrhea, in-
flammatory bowel disease and 
short bowel syndrome.
5-30 g/day orally is a typical 
dose.
Doses in IV or TPN in the 
critically ill may be higher.
